TaskDescription: Executed (not imagined), self-initiated, self-paced reaching movements. Each trial is a rest of at least 5 s with the hands on hand switches (a shorter rest triggered an error message), the movement onset (time 0), then the self-paced execution until the hands are back on the switches. Unilateral: the right thumb presses a button placed in front of the participant; bilateral: both arms reach synchronously. 3 sets of 40 movements per condition (acq-unilateral, acq-bilateral); participants 9-14 (second study) recorded the unilateral condition only.
Instructions: Rest with both hands on the hand switches for at least 5 s, then, whenever you decide, reach and press the button (right thumb, or both arms in the bilateral condition) and return the hands to the switches.
InstitutionName: German Research Centre for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI)
Description: EEG dataset of self-initiated, executed unilateral (right arm) and bilateral reaching movements from 14 healthy subjects (8 in both conditions, 6 in the unilateral condition only), for movement intention recognition in exoskeleton-supported rehabilitation.
